text: Create a skill by writing a SKILL.md file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its toolkit
quote: Create a `SKILL.md` file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its toolkit.

text: A skill is a simple folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and Markdown instructions
quote: Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions.

text: Provides a template skill with name and description frontmatter to start new skills from
quote:
name: template-skill
description: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.

text: Skills are defined as filesystem artifacts, each a SKILL.md in its own directory
quote: Defined as filesystem artifacts**: you create each skill as a `SKILL.md` file in its own directory, such as `.c

text: Claude automatically loads a skill when it judges the skill relevant to the current task
quote: If Claude thinks the skill is relevant to the current task, it will load the skill by reading its full `SKILL.md` into context.

text: Users can invoke a skill directly with a /skill-name slash command
quote: or you can invoke one directly with `/skill-name`.

text: Frontmatter can control whether the user or Claude is allowed to invoke a skill
quote: frontmatter to [control whether you or Claude invokes them](#control-who-invokes-a-skill)

text: Required description field (1-1024 chars) states what the skill does and when to use it
quote: The required `description` field: Must be 1-1024 characters, Should describe both what the skill does and when to use it

text: A skill's body loads only when used, so long reference material costs almost nothing in context until needed
quote: Unlike CLAUDE.md content, a skill's body loads only when it's used, so long reference material costs almost nothing until you need it.

text: Skills can bundle optional scripts, reference docs, and assets in the skill directory, referenced from SKILL.md
quote:
skill-name/
├── SKILL.md          # Required: metadata + instructions
├── scripts/          # Optional: executable code
├── references/       # Optional: documentation
├── assets/           # Optional: templates, resources

text: Bundled skills can be turned off with the disableBundledSkills setting, except /doctor
quote: To turn bundled skills off, use the [`disableBundledSkills`](/docs/en/settings-reference#disablebundledskills) setting, which disables every bundled skill except `/doctor`.

text: Bundled /run and /verify skills work without setup by inferring how to launch the project from its type and config files
quote: `/run` and `/verify` work without setup. They infer the launch from your project type (CLI, server, TUI, browser-driven) and from what's in your README, `package.json`, or `Makefile`.

text: Verify a code change by building and running the app rather than relying on tests or type checks
quote: Build and run your app to confirm a code change does what it should, without falling back to tests or type checks

text: Users can teach /run and /verify how to build and launch their specific project
quote: Teach `/run` and `/verify` how to build and launch your project

text: Legacy .claude/commands files and skills both create the same slash command, and existing command files keep working
quote: A file at `.claude/commands/deploy.md` and a skill at `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` both create `/deploy` and work the same way.

text: Skills follow the open Agent Skills standard that works across multiple AI tools
quote: Claude Code skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard, which works across multiple AI tools.

text: Agent Skills was published as an open standard for cross-platform portability
quote: We've published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability.

text: Ships a skill-creator skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them
quote: A skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them.

text: Benchmark skill performance with variance analysis
quote: benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy

text: Optimize a skill's description to improve its triggering accuracy
quote: optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

text: PDF skill extracts text and tables, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs
quote: description: Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs. Use when working with PDF documents or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.

text: Pre-built Anthropic skills for pptx, xlsx, docx, and pdf documents
quote: Skill IDs | Short names: `pptx`, `xlsx`, `docx`, `pdf`

text: Example skills are already available to paid Claude.ai plans
quote: These example skills are all already available to paid plans in Claude.ai.

text: Skills teach Claude repeatable tasks such as applying brand guidelines or organization-specific data workflows
quote: Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks.

text: Plugins package skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers into one directory that Claude Code installs and loads as one unit
quote: A Claude Code plugin is a directory of skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, or other components that Claude Code installs and loads as one unit.

text: Plugins can be shared across projects and teams
quote: Plugins let you extend Claude Code with custom functionality that can be shared across projects and teams.

text: Plugin manifest .claude-plugin/plugin.json defines plugin name, description, and version
quote: The manifest file at `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` defines your plugin's identity: its name, description, and version.

text: Plugin skills are namespaced and invoked as /plugin-name:skill-name
quote: You can also invoke a plugin skill directly with `/plugin-name:skill-name`.

text: Test a plugin locally using the --plugin-dir flag
quote: add a skill, and test it locally using the \`--plugin-dir\` flag

text: Plugin marketplaces are catalogs for distributing plugins to others with centralized discovery
quote: A **plugin marketplace** is a catalog that lets you distribute plugins to others. Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates

text: Marketplaces provide version tracking and automatic plugin updates
quote: Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and support for multiple source types, including git repositories and local paths.

text: Marketplaces support multiple source types, including git repositories and local paths
quote: Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and support for multiple source types, including git repositories and local paths.

text: Anyone with access can register a marketplace with one command and install plugins from it
quote: anyone with access registers it in Claude Code with one command and installs your plugins from it.

text: Register the anthropics/skills repo as a Claude Code marketplace with one command
quote:
You can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills

text: Install a plugin from a marketplace with /plugin install name@marketplace
quote: /plugin install quality-review-plugin@my-plugins

text: Install the document-skills or example-skills bundles separately from the repo's marketplace
quote:
/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
/plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills

text: Specify skills in the Messages API container parameter by skill_id, type, and optional version, and run them in code execution
quote: You specify Skills in the `container` parameter with a `skill_id`, `type`, and optional `version`, and they run in the code execution environment.

text: Include up to 20 skills per API request
quote: You can include up to 20 Skills for each request.

text: Upload and manage custom skills through the Skills API
quote: Upload and manage through the [Skills API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/skills/create)

text: Custom skills uploaded via the API are private to your workspace
quote: Availability | Available to all users | Private to your workspace

text: Skill Versions API for skill version management
quote: Skill Versions API Reference - Version management

text: Agent SDK controls which skills Claude can invoke, dispatches commands by name, and discovers authored skills
quote: Control which skills Claude can invoke in Claude Agent SDK sessions, dispatch commands by name, and author skills your sessions discover

text: Agent SDK can programmatically load plugins from local directories into agent sessions
quote: Through the Agent SDK, you can programmatically load plugins from local directories to add capabilities to your agent sessions.

text: Agent SDK offers Claude Code's tools, agent loop, and context management in Python and TypeScript
quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code, programmable in Python and TypeScript.

text: Custom subagents run in their own context window with a custom system prompt, tool access, and permissions
quote: Each subagent runs in its own context window with a custom system prompt, specific tool access, and independent permissions.

text: Agent view shows all background sessions: what's running, needs input, or is done
quote: Agent view, opened with `claude agents`, is one screen for all your background sessions: what's running, what needs your input, and what's done.

text: Agent teams coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together
quote: Agent teams let you coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together.

text: Claude Code connects to external tools and data sources via MCP servers
quote: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

text: Administrators can restrict which MCP servers run in the organization or disable MCP entirely
quote: As an administrator, you can restrict which servers run in your organization, from deploying a fixed approved set to disabling MCP entirely

text: Process piped content non-interactively with claude -p
quote: `cat file \| claude -p "query"` | Process piped content

text: Define custom tools with the Agent SDK's in-process MCP server so Claude can call your functions and APIs
quote: Define custom tools with the Claude Agent SDK's in-process MCP server so Claude can call your functions, hit your APIs

text: Scale agents to thousands of tools by discovering and loading only what's needed on demand
quote: Scale your agent to thousands of tools by discovering and loading only what's needed, on demand.

text: Block dangerous operations like destructive shell commands before they execute
quote: Block dangerous operations before they execute, like destructive shell commands or unauthorized file access

text: Track file changes during agent sessions and restore files to any previous state
quote: Track file changes during agent sessions and restore files to any previous state

text: Continue, resume, or fork prior agent sessions
quote: when to use continue, resume, and fork to return to a prior run.

text: Mirror session transcripts to your own storage so other hosts can resume sessions
quote: Mirror Agent SDK session transcripts to your own object store, key-value store, or database so other hosts can resume your sessions.

text: Return validated JSON output from agent workflows using JSON Schema, Zod, or Pydantic
quote: Return validated JSON from agent workflows using JSON Schema, Zod, or Pydantic.

text: Track token usage, estimate costs, and configure prompt caching in the Agent SDK
quote: Learn how to track token usage, estimate costs, and configure prompt caching with the Claude Agent SDK.

text: Export Agent SDK traces, metrics, and events via OpenTelemetry
quote: Export traces, metrics, and events from the Agent SDK to your observability backend using OpenTelemetry.

text: Stream text and tool calls in real time from the Agent SDK
quote: Get real-time responses from the Agent SDK as text and tool calls stream in
